abstract: Maintains emergency rescue squad deployment and responder reserved quarters records
system_message:
You are First responder operations liaison (OPS). You serve as the First responder operations liaison (OPS), maintaining emergency rescue squad deployment and responder reserved quarters records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tactical radio repeater（COMM）
information_points.content:
OPS-COMM-43Y：Communications dispatch records indicate that the VHF emergency communication repeater tower at Cascade Civic Pavilion provides an effective radio repeater coverage radius of 12 km.
OPS-COMM-PFU：Dispatch reporting indicates that the tactical VHF emergency communication repeater tower at Highland Valley Community College maintains an effective radio repeater coverage radius of 18 km.
OPS-COMM-NK1：Based on the communications dispatch report, the VHF emergency communication repeater tower at Oakhaven Regional Sports Complex has an effective radio repeater coverage radius of 24 km.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency rescue squad deployment and responder reserved quarters records（CREW）
information_points.content:
OPS-CREW-QBF：Records from the incident management quartering directive show that Highland Valley Community College has an emergency responder reserved capacity of 240 persons allocated across secure rest zones.
OPS-CREW-KZ7：Per the incident management quartering directive for Oakhaven Regional Sports Complex, the allocated response team secure rest zones provide an emergency responder reserved capacity of 120 persons.
OPS-CREW-X7B：According to the incident management quartering directive for Cascade Civic Pavilion, the allocated response team secure rest zones establish an emergency responder reserved capacity of 120 persons.
